evals.name: portrait-explainer-new-topic
evals.prompt: make me one of those animated linkedin infographic gifs explaining how retrieval-augmented generation works. the before is an LLM answering from memory and hallucinating, the after is retrieving the right documents first and citing them
evals.expected_output: A looping GIF (about 1080x1350) with a before and an after flow, four numbered principles, a bar chart with a drawn trend arrow, animated connectors; no text overflow; the chart labelled illustrative or backed by no invented statistics.

evals.name: square-format
evals.prompt: I need a square 1080x1080 animated GIF for a post about the three phases of a clinical trial (phase 1 safety, phase 2 efficacy signals, phase 3 confirmation). Make it look like the other infographic gifs.
evals.expected_output: A 1080x1080 looping GIF that kept the visual style but cut content to fit: no overflow, no clipped text, animation still present (connectors, fills or bars).

evals.name: match-a-reference
evals.prompt: here is a screen recording of a gif I like (path given). build me one in the same style about how to read a forest plot, in my own words
evals.expected_output: The agent runs analyze_reference.py on the recording, uses its report to choose loop length and animated regions, and produces an original infographic (not a copy of the source text).
